title: Withdraw an application to revoke a registered relationship
summary: Learn how to withdraw an application to revoke a registered relationship if you submitted it within the last 90 days.
intro:
The NSW relationships register provides legal recognition for de facto partners.

If you've submitted an application to revoke your registered relationship within the last 90 days and you wish to withdraw it, you can lodge your request by mail or in person at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You must have submitted an application to revoke your registered relationship within the last 90 days.
If both parties applied to revoke the relationship, either party can apply to withdraw the application.
If only one party applied to revoke the relationship, only that party can apply to withdraw the application.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Notice to withdraw an application to revoke a registered relationship'
Four certified copies of personal identity documents as specified on the form

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application either in person at a service centre, or by mail to the details on the form.

more_info.text: There is no fee to withdraw your application to revoke a relationship, but the original fee paid is non-refundable.
